lessons_used: sign_in, copy changes remain consistently helpful, winning 5 out of 8 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes are helpful, winning 3 out of 6 tests (+1.8% average after noise correction), while 1 performed worse and 2 showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, winning 2 out of 6 tests (+2.0% average after noise correction), while 4 showed no clear effect.
finish, new_screen changes failed to sustain early success, with 3 out of 4 tests performing worse or showing no clear effect (-1.3% average after noise correction).
home, new_flow, finish, redesign, choose_path, copy, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect or performed worse across multiple tests.
Predictions were overly optimistic for finish, new_screen, finish, redesign, and choose_path, copy changes, predicting positive gains where actual results were mostly negative or had no clear effect.

candidates.title: Split Layout Pet Naming Certificate View
candidates.change: Rebuild the adoption certificate screen into a side-by-side split layout displaying the pet live preview next to the official naming input form.
candidates.why: Adoption redesigns performed well (+1.8% average boost), while 3 support tickets mentioned issues during custom pet generation or adoption display.

adoption_certificate.headline: Name & Officialize Your New Pet Companion

guard.reason: Redesigns adoption certificate layout while retaining its core function.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns show solid performance (+1.8% average), backed by 3 support tickets, but requires full screen redesign.

candidates.title: Account Pet Retention & Re-login Guarantee Headline
candidates.change: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in preserves their saved pets and prevents data resets.
candidates.why: Sign-in copy changes consistently win (+2.3% average gain), directly addressing 8 support emails regarding pets disappearing or resetting after signing in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Saved Pet
sign_in.body: Your companion and customizations are linked to your account. Signing in guarantees your pet data will never reset or vanish.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to explain account retention benefits without dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in copy changes consistently win (+2.3%), strongly supported by 8 support tickets and very low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Render & Engine Load Status Info
candidates.change: Display explicit status progress indicators and initialization stage text on the waiting screen while desktop rendering sets up.
candidates.why: Home wait_info tests won +2.0% on average, helping address the high 201s median / 2336s mean waiting time and 3 support tickets about desktop pet render failures.

waiting.body: Initializing desktop graphics engine and rendering your pet companion...

guard.reason: Adds progress indicators to the waiting screen within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info interventions show strong track record (+2.0%) and directly address the extreme 2336s mean waiting time.

candidates.title: List Layout Path Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Reframe the choose path screen using a structured list layout that clearly differentiates starter instant adoption from custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Choose path has a long mean time (514s) and an 81.7% conversion rate, so a clear list view helps users make an immediate decision without hesitation.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose path layout while keeping both path options intact.

candidates.score_note: Choose path redesigns average +1.7% lift across 3 tests, targeting a high drop-off and 514s mean completion time.

candidates.title: Companion Trait & Voice Setup Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a companion trait configuration screen after selecting a pet where users configure personality style and interaction feedback.
candidates.why: Resolves user confusion reported in support emails (3 tickets) regarding how to interact with and control the pet post-onboarding.

new_companion_traits.headline: Configure Pet Personality & Voice
new_companion_traits.body: Select your desktop companion's interaction preferences and voice responses before completing setup.

guard.reason: Adds a new companion trait configuration screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption new_flow tested well (+7.1% single test), but adding screens has mixed historical success overall and zero cost score.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls & Shortcut Summary Copy
candidates.change: Update the home intro text with explicit interaction guidance detailing mouse dragging, system tray controls, and hide/show shortcuts.
candidates.why: Directly targets the 3 support emails expressing post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click and drag to move your pet around your screen. Right-click the tray icon anytime to access controls, chat, or hide your companion.

guard.reason: Updates home intro copy with helpful interaction guidance.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop-off step (23%) and 3 support tickets with low-cost copy updates, though finish copy history is modest.

candidates.title: Account Re-Authentication Pet Protection Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit explanatory hint under sign-in buttons clarifying that account login keeps pet progress saved across app updates.
candidates.why: Leverages the strong win rate of sign-in microcopy/hints while mitigating user anxiety over lost pets (8 support emails).

sign_in.hint: Signing in anchors your pet to your account so progress is preserved across app updates and re-installations.

guard.reason: Adds an explanatory sign-in hint describing account data retention.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints perform well (+1.9%) and directly address 8 support emails regarding data security anxiety.

candidates.title: Desktop Engine Launch Notification Prompt
candidates.change: Provide an opt-in system notification trigger on the waiting screen to alert users when the desktop engine finishes loading.
candidates.why: The waiting step suffers from a 2336s mean duration; letting users minimize the app and receive a notification reduces drop-off (11.7% abandon on home).

waiting.hint: Enable desktop notification to get alerted as soon as your pet is live on screen.

guard.reason: Adds an opt-in notification prompt on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications showed virtually no gain (-0.1% across 2 tests) despite long wait times.

candidates.title: Early Adoption Certificate Confirmation Sequence
candidates.change: Move the adoption certificate confirmation screen directly after friend selection, placing photo uploads as an optional final step.
candidates.why: Adoption mean duration is high (1017s); securing the adoption certificate upfront builds commitment before custom photo processing.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Spotlight Layout Home Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight view focusing on key desktop interaction controls alongside the mascot preview.
candidates.why: The finish step drops 23% of users; replacing standard text with a spotlight layout increases clarity and onboarding completion rate.

guard.reason: Redesigns home intro layout while retaining setup guidance.

candidates.score_note: Finish redesigns consistently failed (-3.8% avg over 2 tests); lessons warn against optimistic predictions here.
